processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The hot-rolled plate (parent process proc_hr) was annealed at 700 °C for 1 h followed by water quenching. At 700 °C the γ phase almost totally decomposed to lamellar κ-carbide and α matrix by the eutectoid reaction γ → α + κ; no γ phase was detected by XRD. Hot rolling/annealing schedule shown in Fig. 1.

phases_present.morphology: large α grains; dark featureless α region; banded/long-strip α
phases_present.volume_fraction: > 0.8 at 700 °C (α curve peaks above the 0.8 gridline, Fig. 14)

phases_present.crystal_structure: perovskite structure based on FCC lattice, space group Pm3m
phases_present.morphology: fine lamellar/rod-like κ-carbide in the α matrix; continuous κ-carbide along grain boundaries of large α grains; some globular or short-rod-like κ

precipitates.coherency: Nishiyama–Wasserman (N–W) orientation relationship with the α matrix for some lamellae
precipitates.distribution: lamellar within the α matrix; continuous along the grain boundaries of large α grains

precipitates.coherency: no orientation relationship with the α matrix

structures.number_of_phases: 2 (α ferrite and κ-carbide; no γ phase detected)
structures.overall_structure: After annealing at 700 °C for 1 h the γ phase has almost totally decomposed to α phase and lamellar κ-carbide by the eutectoid reaction γ → α + κ; no γ phase is detected by XRD (Fig. 14). The microstructure is composed of large α grains, continuous κ-carbide along grain boundaries, and areas containing lamellar κ-carbide within the γ matrix.
